probe: portrait image-load verification (one-off, offline evidence; the pipeline never calls ESPN)
rate_limit: at most 4 requests per second (>= 0.26 s between requests)
method: HEAD per address (no redirects followed); ranged GET of 16 bytes on a few to read the PNG signature
verified_image_definition: HTTP 200 and an image/* Content-Type. Not a check that the picture shows the right person.
